$comment: iTantra Semantic Packet — the entire payload sent between phones. Typical size: 120-180 bytes.

msg_id.description: Short unique ID per utterance, e.g. first 8 chars of a UUID

lang.description: ISO 639-1 language code of the utterance

urgency.description: high = emergency keyword detected or high amplitude/urgent speech pattern; triggers alert playback on receiver

confidence.description: STT confidence score, 0.0-1.0. Optional but recommended for the low-confidence 'please repeat' flow.

ts.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds, captured at start of utterance. Used for end-to-end latency measurement.
